# Engineering -- rules and checks (generated from engineering.json; do not edit)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **status** | generated by build_kit.py; source of record is `angles/engineering.json` |
| **updated** | on every `build_kit.py` run |
| Purpose | Fix what the app is made of, what must still work after a later edit, and keep the record current without touching the fields the server owns. |
| Artifact | the Engineering rows and the ## Changes list in APP.md; the frameworkKit stamp is displayed here but written by the server |

## Questions

| E1 | Which files is this app made of, and which one opens first? | page | no | prefilled |

## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EN-1 | The folder is the app and module.json is its manifest: id equals the folder name, and schema, id, name, kind, status, version are always present. | page, chat, link | schemas/app-manifest.schema.json required keys | modules_pkg.validate_manifest; C17 |
| EN-2 | Content files first and module.json last, complete, in one write. A folder with no manifest is not listed; a manifest caught mid-write renders as a building row. | page, chat, link | modules_api.py _building_row; static/js/18-modules.js building note | the panel row is the proof; server materialization writes the manifest last |
| EN-3 | version and updated_ms belong to the server. The chat never bumps or writes them. An accepted migration is not an edit: it writes the two stamp copies only. | page, chat, link | modules_api.py touch_app and apply_action; APPS-EVENTS.md | C21; the server owns the bump; test_kit_upgrade.py |
| EN-4 | The chat never writes events. Every app.created and app.edited row is the server's. | page, chat, link | APPS-EVENTS.md | C18 (no hand-written event file in the folder) |
| EN-5 | Only module.json, index.html and assets/** travel when the app is shared. APP.md stays on this machine, which is why the stamp is mirrored into the manifest. | page, chat, link | modules_pkg.py whitelist; APPS-THREATS.md X-3 | C18 names the non-travelling files; C20 checks the mirror |
| EN-6 | Size caps: at most 200 files, 5 MB per file, 20 MB total, and a page's index.html at most 512 KB. | page, chat, link | modules_pkg.py MAX_MEMBERS/MAX_FILE/MAX_TOTAL; modules_api.py HTML_MAX | C19, reading the constants from the runtime |
| EN-7 | Sharing needs manifest schema 2. A schema 1 app is never rewritten in bulk; it bumps itself on its next edit. | page, chat, link | modules_pkg.py export refusal; schemas/MIGRATIONS.md M-2 | C24, advisory until P7 names someone else |
| EN-8 | Fields the kit adds to module.json are carried through untouched on every read and write back, which is the only reason the stamp can live there. | page, chat, link | schemas/app-manifest.schema.json additionalProperties; schemas/MIGRATIONS.md unknown fields | read-time normalize is a projection; C20 |
| EN-9 | The stamp is written once, at create, by the server. A newer plugin exposes a newer kit to new apps only; an existing app keeps its kit until its owner accepts a migration in Edit. | page, chat, link | FOUNDER-DIRECTIONS.md D75 ruling 2; schemas/MIGRATIONS.md | server write path plus the upgrade no-rewrite test; C20 checks presence and agreement |
| EN-10 | Every edit session appends one dated line to ## Changes. | page, chat, link | APPS-EVENTS.md | C23 |
| EN-11 | On import, the server reconstructs an APP.md skeleton from module.json plus the mirrored stamp; every answer it cannot recover is written as 'not recorded'. | page, chat, link | ADR-039 Decision; modules_pkg.py import path | deferred to the Publish program (design v1 scope R1-P6); C1 reports 'not recorded' cells as WARN |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C17 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | module.json parses, carries the required keys with the right types, and its id equals the folder name. | json.load then jsonschema against app-manifest.schema.json (falling back to the explicit key and type checks of modules_pkg.validate_manifest); id == basename, matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$, not sys- |
| C18 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | The folder holds only the files this kind is allowed, plus APP.md, and no hand-written event log. | walk ignoring dot directories; per-kind allow set (page: module.json, index.html, assets/**; chat: module.json, data-policy.json; link: module.json) plus APP.md; anything else named as 'will not travel'; a *.events.* file FAILs |
| C19 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | Size stays inside the caps. | count members and stat sizes against MAX_MEMBERS, MAX_FILE, MAX_TOTAL from modules_pkg; a page's index.html against HTML_MAX from modules_api |
| C20 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | The stamp is present on the APP.md header line and mirrored in module.json, and the two agree. | first non-blank APP.md line matches ^frameworkKit: \{.*\}$ and parses; module.json.frameworkKit parses; version, digest (12 hex) and created_at agree; installed kit newer than the stamp is WARN never FAIL |
| C21 | required | page, chat, link | suggest | The fields the server owns were not hand-written. | version is an int >= 1; updated_ms absent or an int; drift comparison is left to the server |
| C22 | required | page, chat, link | suggest | The E2 regression check names something a person can open and see after an edit. | cell >= 12 characters, one verb from the open set (open, click, paste, reopen, read, run) and one from the observe set (see, reads, shows, lands, top row, asks); a cell identical to P3 passes when it satisfies the shape |
| C23 | required | page, chat, link | suggest | The newest ## Changes line is dated and not older than the manifest's updated_at. | first bullet under ## Changes starts with YYYY-MM-DD; parsed date >= date(updated_at) |
| C24 | advisory | page, chat, link | suggest | schema is 2, which export requires; blocking once P7 names someone besides the builder. | raw.get('schema') == 2; the failure quotes the export refusal wording; the profile promotes the level from the P7 answer |
